1. Interface naming rules
Interface names use the prefix If_. Provided ports use Pp and required ports use Rp. Data-element names use
descriptive CamelCase names followed by a unit suffix when a numeric unit is applicable.

3. Relationship constraints
Every required port shall reference a declared interface. Each sender-receiver interface shall have exactly one logical
provider in this synthetic architecture. A provided port may have zero or more consumers, but unused interfaces shall
be reported for review.
4. Source precedence
Priority

5. Citation requirement
Answers shall cite the source file, page number, and section. If evidence is absent, the system shall return insufficient
evidence rather than infer a relationship.
6. Controlled duplicate
If_VehicleSpeed appears in both revision-specific HLDs. This is valid across versions and must not be treated as a
same-version duplicate when the document version filter is applied.
